title: LITE-1b what a web device wants pushed
description: GET /v1/notifications/prefs and PUT {expected_revision, changes} (409 stale_revision when another tab changed them first), web credential only. `changes` may hold any of kinds (a partial map), snooze_until, quiet_when_native_connected, quiet_at_desk (NOTIFY-1), lang. `host_enabled` is the switch on the host's Devices page and is not the device's to change.

herdr_done.description: NOTIFY-1: an agent in a Herdr pane finished and nobody has looked at it yet (state.unseen). Off by default.

snooze_until.description: Unix seconds; nothing is pushed before it.

quiet_when_native_connected.description: NOTIFY-2: hold a push back only while a native Omodachi App of this host is in front (live /v1/events stream, PUT /v1/presence foreground) and says it alerts that kind itself. A kind the App does not alert is always pushed. (LITE-1b: any native companion with a live stream held back every kind.)

quiet_at_desk.description: NOTIFY-1: hold pushes while the person is at the computer (state.desk.present) and send what is still waiting once they leave it or lock it; what was answered at the computer meanwhile is dropped. Default true. Herdr pushes also wait 30 s and go as one digest per host (tag herdr), whatever this says.

lang.description: The language the host writes this device's push titles in.
